privacy.title: Privacy & personal data
privacy.intro: This page describes what data the practice match board stores and why. The site is run privately by {{name}}.
privacy.whatBody: When you post a match we store team name, time, venue, age, level, format, any cost and other info, plus the contact person's name, phone number and email. When you book a slot we store team name, contact details and an optional message.
privacy.whoBody: The organiser's contact details are shown publicly so that other teams can get in touch. Names of teams that booked are also public. A booker's contact details and message are only visible to the organiser via the manage link.
privacy.whyBody: The data is only used so that teams can find each other and book practice matches. It is not sold or used for advertising. You give your consent when you post or book a match.
privacy.howLongBody: Matches and bookings, including contact details, are deleted automatically 30 days after the match day. You can cancel your match or booking at any time.
privacy.browserTitle: What is stored in your browser?
privacy.browserBody: The site uses no tracking cookies. Your browser stores manage keys for matches you posted and slots you booked, the team name in the search field and your light/dark choice. You can remove it at any time by clearing site data.
privacy.removeBody: Contact {{name}} at {{email}} and we will remove it. You also have the right to know what data is stored about you.
